description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Derevi.
Derevi enters the battlefield, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability to draw infinite cards.
